d:
Indulge in the sweetness of style with the official video song "Sweety" from the blockbuster movie Race Gurram.
Witness Icon Star Allu Arjun and Shruti Haasan set the screen on fire with their incredible chemistry and effortless dance moves. Composed by S.S. Thaman and sung with high energy by Siddharth Mahadevan and Rrabbit, this song captures the fun and youthful spirit of the film.
